separation_invariants: Semantic identity, lifecycle state, source currentness, validation result, authority state, and publication state are independent axes.
A digest change creates a new candidate epoch; it cannot refresh an old admission decision.
PASS does not imply owner review, admission, publication, implementation, or correctness.
Directory placement and generated projections never change lifecycle state.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines lifecycle vocabulary and transition preconditions only. It does not transition, review, admit, supersede, or withdraw any Definition.
